reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: This app literally last for like five minutes and then it keeps crashing constantly. Brand new phone so it’s not that.

reviews.title: Gathers/Sells Your Info Before Even Using The App- Do Not Use
reviews.text: Why do you have to gather and sell our info with your partners? So we can get bombarded/spammed with all-things baby related? We’re just trying to match baby names without selling out. No thanks. Pure hassle. 0/10.

reviews.title: Didn’t Work
reviews.text: I tried to create a log in and the page would freeze giving an error code 401 but didn’t tell me how to fix or what that meant. Tried a couple of times and it wouldn’t work so I deleted the app.
